items.Sentence: flows through an eight-inch sewer main into the equalization tank for pre-treatment
The headworks are housed in a 5 feet x 10 feet below-grade concrete tank, with dual channels and bar screens
The aeration tanks consist of two 53 feet x 53 feet below-grade concrete basins, each equipped with a floating mechanical aerator to facilitate complete mix, extended aeration secondary treatment
The wastewater then flows to the secondary clarifiers for sludge settling and removal, which consist of two 18 feet diameter concrete tanks
The RAS/WAS pump station is comprised of two rotary lobe pumps ... capable of returning or wasting the settled sludge from the secondary clarifiers
The aerobic digesters are two 18 feet x 18 feet above-ground concrete tanks where the sludge digestion process is completed
the WAS is sent to the Sludge Drying Beds until it becomes dry enough to haul away to an appropriate landfill
Sludge generated from the treatment process is regularly hauled offsite from sludge drying Beds to an approved landfill
From the clarifiers, the effluent flows into the effluent wetwell
The storage basins are below-grade concrete lined ponds with a total capacity of 225,000 cubic feet of storage
The clarified effluent is pumped to an adjacent field on the site and used for spray irrigation
Wash down aerators and finals. Add chlorine, if odor problems
